statement.p: Find the velocity and acceleration vectors for the motion described by x = 7-2t^{2}, \quad y = 4+2t^{2}, \quad z = 3-t^{2}.

static.solution:
\vec{v} is given by: \vec{v} = \frac{d}{dt}\,\left((7-2t^{2})\vec i + (4+2t^{2})\vec j + (3-t^{2})\vec k\right) = -4t\,\mathit{\vec i}+4t\,\mathit{\vec j}-2t\,\mathit{\vec k}.
The acceleration vector \vec{a} is given by: \vec{a} = \frac{d}{dt}\,\vec v = -4\,\mathit{\vec i}+4\,\mathit{\vec j}-2\,\mathit{\vec k}.
